P.name: A Thousand Cuts
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Gwen's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}}, the center of ''{{ai|Snip Snip!|Gwen}}'', and ''{{ai|Needlework|Gwen}}'' deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|1% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.6}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}.
P.description2:
''A Thousand Cuts'' is modified based on the target:
* {{tip|heal|Heals}} '''Gwen''' for 67% of {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after resistances and most modifiers.}} dealt against {{tip|champion|champions}}, capped at {{pplevel|12 to 40}} {{as|(+ 7% AP)}} per instance.
* Deals an additional {{as|{{pplevel|8 to 30}} '''bonus''' magic damage}} against {{tip|minions}} that are {{as|'''below''' 40% health}}.
* Deals a maximum of {{as|3 {{as|(+ 5% AP)}} magic damage|magic damage}} against {{tip|monsters}}.

Q.name: Snip Snip!
Q.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Gwen's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Snippy'' {{tip|on-hit}} for 6 seconds, stacking up to 4 times and refreshing on subsequent attacks.
Q.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gwen''' snips at least twice with her scissors in a {{tt|cone|see notes}} in the target direction over the cast time, dealing {{as|magic damage}} per snip to all enemies within the area, with the final snip dealing increased damage. The center of each snip converts 50% of the damage to {{ccs|{{sti|{{as|true damage}}}}|true}}, then applies ''{{ai|A Thousand Cuts|Gwen}}''. ''Snip Snip!'' deals 80% damage against {{tip|minions}}, and executes them on the first damage instance if they are {{as|'''below''' 20% health}}.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Damage per Snip|{{ap|10 to 26}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5}}% AP)}}|Center Damage per Snip|{{ap|10 to 26}} {{as|(+ {{ap|5}}% AP)}}
{{ai|A Thousand Cuts|Gwen|{{as|(+ 1% {{as|(+ {{fd|0.6}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}}} {{st|Final Snip Damage|{{ap|60 to 160}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}|Final Snip Center Damage|{{ap|60 to 160}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}}
{{ai|A Thousand Cuts|Gwen|{{as|(+ 1% {{as|(+ {{ap|0.6*1}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}}}
Q.description3: If '''Gwen''' has any ''Snippy'' stacks, she consumes them to snip an additional time for each.
Q.leveling3:
{{st|Minimum Damage|{{ap|60+10*1 to 160+26*1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35+5*1}}% AP)}}|Minimum Center Damage|{{ap|60+10*1 to 160+26*1}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35+5*1}}% AP)}}
{{ai|A Thousand Cuts|Gwen|{{as|(+ {{ap|1+1*1}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|0.6+0.6*1}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}}} {{st|Maximum Damage|{{ap|60+10*5 to 160+26*5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35+5*5}}% AP)}}|Maximum Center Damage|{{ap|60+10*5 to 160+26*5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35+5*5}}% AP)}}
{{ai|A Thousand Cuts|Gwen|{{as|(+ {{ap|1+1*5}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|0.6+0.6*5}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}}}

W.name: Hallowed Mist
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gwen''' summons the Hallowed Mist upon her current location, lasting for 4 seconds. ''Hallowed Mist'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and does so automatically if '''Gwen''' attempts to leave the area.
W.description2: While inside the mist, '''Gwen''' becomes {{tip|ghosted}}, gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} and is {{tip|untargetable}} to all enemies (except {{tip|turret|turrets}} and {{tip|monsters}}) outside of the mist.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Gwen''' commands the mist to move to her current location.
W.description4: '''''Gwen''' negates all attacks by {{tip|monsters}} outside of the mist.''

E.name: Skip 'n Slash
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gwen''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target location, then empowers her {{tip|basic attacks}} within the next 4 seconds to deal 15 {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} and gain {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|75 '''bonus''' attack range}}.
E.description2: '''Gwen's''' first basic attack within the duration refunds a percentage of ''Skip 'n Slash's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
E.description3: ''Skip 'n Slash {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Gwen's''' basic attack timer, and can be cast during any of her abilities, and vice versa.''

R.name: Needlework
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Gwen''' launches a needle in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
R.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage per Needle|{{ap|30 to 70}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Damage with {{ai|A Thousand Cuts|Gwen}}|{{ap|30 to 70}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}} {{as|(+ 1% {{as|(+ {{ap|0.6*1}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|30 to 60}}%}}
R.description2: ''Needlework'' can be recast twice more within 8 seconds of the activation at no additional cost, with a 1-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} between casts. Each subsequent cast refreshes the duration and increases the number of needles launched by 2. Needle hits beyond the first apply a {{tip|slow}} against each individual target.
R.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Gwen''' mimics the first cast's effects, while barraging three needles on the second cast and five on the third cast.
R.leveling3:
{{st|Second Cast Total Damage|{{ap|30*3 to 70*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*3}}% AP)}}
{{ai|A Thousand Cuts|Gwen|{{as|(+ {{ap|1*3}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|0.6*3}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}|Third Cast Total Damage|{{ap|30*5 to 70*5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*5}}% AP)}}
{{ai|A Thousand Cuts|Gwen|{{as|(+ {{ap|1*5}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|0.6*5}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}|Maximum Total Damage|{{ap|30*9 to 70*9}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*9}}% AP)}}
{{ai|A Thousand Cuts|Gwen|{{as|(+ {{ap|1*9}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|0.6*9}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}}}
R.description4: '''''Gwen''' can move during Needlework's cast times.''
